title: Chapter 507 - 507 Return; It’Ll Be Successful As Long As It’S Built (1)
content:
Chapter 507 - 507 Return; It’Ll Be Successful As Long As It’S Built (1)

Chapter 507 - 507 Return; It’ll Be Successful as Long as It’s Built (1)

507 Return; It’ll Be Successful as Long as It’s Built (1)

These 700,000 red packets…

Obviously, it was from the seven billion yuan he had spent to purchase the Totamac device.

Lin Fan muttered, “700,000 red packets. I don’t think I’ve ever accumulated so many red packets.”

“Let’s see what I can get.”

At this point, even Lin Fan could not help but reveal a look of anticipation on his face.

[Do you wish to open 700,000 red packets?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received one yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 9,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the skill Poison Immunity.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a Constitution Enhancement Potion.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received Hearing Enhancement Potion.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 10% of Dahl Group’s shares.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 10% of Dior’s shares.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a random rebate card.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 10% of Peugeot Group’s shares.]

…

700,000 red packets…

Lin Fan received a total of 1,940,300 yuan.

This bit of money was not even worth what he got from breathing, sleeping, and walking every day, so he naturally did not care.

He had obtained a total of four one-yuan critical hit cards. If he spent a total of four yuan, he would immediately receive 400 million yuan.

Dahl Group was the largest oil company in the country, with a market value of about 140 billion US dollars, which was close to one trillion yuan. 10% of the shares were 100 billion yuan!

Dior was a famous luxury goods company. Its jewelry and cosmetics products were world-famous. Its market value was about 20 billion US dollars, which was close to 140 billion yuan. 10% of the shares were 14 billion yuan!

Peugeot Group was the largest car company in the country. At the same time, it was also one of the top ten car companies in the world. Its market value was 22 billion USD, which was about 150 billion yuan. 10% of the shares were 15 billion yuan!

Lin Fan had used the random rebate card not long ago.

After spending, he would randomly be given a refund. Lin Fan had spent seven billion previously, and he got 14 billion back. This was a pretty good thing.

As for the double shares coupon, he could instantly increase his shares in a company one time.

Even though money was just a string of numbers to Lin Fan, making the number a little bigger would also feel better.

Therefore, he directly used the double shares coupon on Dahl Group.

Instantly, Lin Fan owned 20% of Dahl Group’s shares.

At this moment, two bottles of potions appeared in front of Lin Fan.

One bottle was transparent, while the other was light red.

One of the bottles was a Constitution Enhancement Potion. Lin Fan had used it several times and had a good understanding of it. It could greatly increase the speed, constitution, strength, and so on.

He did not hesitate too much and directly poured the potion into his mouth.

After drinking the potion, his body felt slightly warm.

Then, a surge of power surged into his heart.

He did not try anything. He picked up the Hearing Enhancement Potion beside him and poured it into his mouth.

Instantly, Lin Fan heard a soft sound in his ears.

Then, he heard the pedestrians downstairs greeting each other, the sound of the river flowing in the distance, and the sound of sewer workers walking underground… It was very magical.

After that, Lin Fan turned his attention to the skill, Poison Immunity.

[Poison Immunity: The ability to resist all poisons. Poison Immunity shows unlimited charm!]

…

In other words, after spending seven billion yuan, Lin Fan obtained 229 billion yuan worth of company shares, 430 million yuan in cash, a bottle of Constitution Enhancement Potion, a bottle of Hearing Enhancement Potion, and Poison Immunity.

A great harvest!

It was definitely a great harvest!

Even Lin Fan could not help but smile.

…

The next day.

Under the farewell of Shangri-La’s chairman, Li Hui, and many senior executives and under the welcome of many beautiful air stewardesses of Xia Airlines…

Lin Fan, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Liu Qianqian, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others took the luxury plane back to Jiangbei.

In the next few days, Lin Fan went back and forth between the Coiling Dragon Villa and Jiangbei University as usual.

On this day, Lin Fan was sitting in his office chair and playing with his phone.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu suddenly stood up. He held a stack of draft paper and excitedly came in front of Lin Fan. “Professor Lin, what do you think of my answer to the third question?”

…

Lin Fan picked up the draft paper and flipped through it quickly. He nodded and said, “Good answer.”

It had to be said that Hao Zhiwu was quite capable.

Once he put his heart into learning, he would be able to achieve results very quickly.

Hao Zhiwu immediately smiled when he heard that.

Perhaps because Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and Hao Zhiwu had completed the third question one after another, which caused Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others to feel pressure.

Perhaps, they were like Hao Zhiwu. After seeing Lin Fan’s status and wealth, they became motivated.

On the same day, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and Nie Zhenjiang also solved the third question.

“Professor Lin, we’ve all solved the third question.” Hao Zhiwu could not help but laugh. “Shall we go to the game world to celebrate?”

“Didn’t you say that games are a stumbling block to your studies?” Liu Qianqian pouted.
